changed.title: Zero deletions suffice with an empty shore for the five-by-five pairing atlas representative 25298977
changed.statement:
let G := fun (i j : Fin 5) => (25298977 : ℕ).testBit (5 * i.val + j.val)
let u : ℕ := 0
let t : ℕ := 0
(∃ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (K L : Finset (Fin 5)),
    L ⊆ K ∧ L.card ≤ u ∧ 5 ≤ K.card + t ∧
    ∀ i ∈ K, ∀ j ∈ K,
      Bool.xor (Bool.xor (G i (π i)) (G j (π j))) (Bool.xor (G i (π j)) (G j (π i))) =
      Bool.xor (decide (i ∈ L)) (decide (j ∈ L)))
changed.unlocks: certifies the zero endpoint of the bounded-shore deletion curve for atlas representative 25298977
changed.context: Use column images 3,4,2,1,0 in row order. Retain all five labels and take the empty shore. The ten unordered pairs each have four-corner XOR zero. Diagonal pairs cancel, and reversing the pair preserves parity. This same witness works at every larger shore budget.
